fields.label: MRP Price List
fields.description: Franchise bills always use the rate from this price list

fields.label: Allow billing without stock
fields.description: If off, a franchise cannot bill more than the stock it has

fields.label: Auto close after (days)
fields.description: A day with bills that is still not closed after this many days is closed by the system with the book stock. 0 = never.

fields.label: Average sales over (days)
fields.description: Tomorrow's order = average daily sales of these days + safety margin - stock in hand - already ordered

fields.label: Safety Margin %
fields.description: Extra on top of average sales, for item groups not listed below

fields.label: Franchise must confirm delivery
fields.description: On: a BDF invoice makes a pending delivery; the stock is added only when the franchise confirms it, minus anything short or damaged. Off: the stock is added as soon as the invoice is submitted.

fields.label: Auto receive after (days)
fields.description: A delivery not confirmed this many days after its invoice date is taken in full by the system (marked Auto Received). 0 = never (the day close still takes it in before closing).
